AI.title_translation: 对单细胞基因组学中预处理和整合方法的基准测试
AI.tldr: 基准测试了单细胞数据分析中预处理、整合和降维方法的多种组合。结果显示Harmony和Seurat是最佳的整合工具，UMAP是最佳的降维工具。
AI.motivation: 单细胞多模态测序数据整合是一个重大的分析挑战，但目前缺乏对不同预处理策略下整合方法的系统性评估。
AI.method: 评估了一个包含标准化、数据整合和降维的通用单细胞数据分析流程。使用了六个多样化的数据集，并组合了七种标准化方法、四种降维方法和五种整合方法。评估指标包括轮廓系数得分（Silhouette Coefficient Score）、调整兰德指数（Adjusted Rand Index）和Calinski-Harabasz指数。
AI.result: Seurat和Harmony在数据整合方面表现出色，其中Harmony对大型数据集更具时间效率。UMAP是与整合技术最兼容的降维方法。最佳的标准化方法取决于所使用的整合方法。
AI.conclusion: Harmony和Seurat是优秀的整合方法，Harmony在处理大数据集时更快。UMAP是推荐的降维方法。最佳的预处理（标准化）策略应根据所选的整合方法进行调整。
AI.translation: 单细胞数据分析通过在单细胞层面表征疾病相关的分子变化，有可能彻底改变个性化医疗。先进的单细胞多模态测定现在可以同时测量数十万个独立细胞中的各种分子（例如DNA、RNA、蛋白质），提供全面的分子读数。一个重要的分析挑战是整合跨不同模态的单细胞测量结果。人们已经开发了各种方法来应对这一挑战，但目前尚未对这些技术与不同预处理策略进行系统评估。本研究考察了一个通用的单细胞数据分析流程，其中包括标准化、数据整合和降维。不同算法组合的性能通常取决于数据集的大小和特性。我们使用三种指标：轮廓系数得分、调整兰德指数和Calinski-Harabasz指数，评估了跨越不同模态、组织和生物体的六个数据集。我们的实验涉及七种标准化方法、四种降维方法和五种整合方法的组合。结果显示，Seurat和Harmony在数据整合方面表现出色，其中Harmony更具时间效率，尤其对于大型数据集。UMAP是与整合技术最兼容的降维方法，而标准化方法的选择则取决于所使用的整合方法。
AI.summary: 本研究旨在系统评估单细胞基因组学中数据整合方法与不同预处理策略的性能。研究建立了一个包含标准化、整合和降维的通用分析流程，并在一系列多样化的数据集上测试了多种算法组合。评估结果表明，Seurat和Harmony在数据整合方面表现卓越，其中Harmony在大型数据集上具有显著的时间效率优势。此外，UMAP被发现是最兼容的降维方法，而最佳的标准化方法则需根据具体的整合方法来确定。
AI.keywords: 预处理, 单细胞基因组学, 数据整合, 基准测试, 多模态测定
AI.comments: 这篇论文的创新点在于首次对单细胞数据分析流程中的关键步骤——标准化、整合和降维——的多种组合进行了系统且大规模的基准测试。其重要性在于为研究人员提供了实用的、基于证据的最佳实践指导，尤其是在处理日益增长的复杂多模态单细胞数据集时。通过量化不同方法在不同数据集特性下的表现（包括效率），它帮助用户做出明智的工具选择。

title: When Does Quantum Differential Privacy Compose?
summary:
Composition is a cornerstone of classical differential privacy, enabling strong end-to-end guarantees for complex algorithms through composition theorems (e.g., basic and advanced). In the quantum setting, however, privacy is defined operationally against arbitrary measurements, and classical composition arguments based on scalar privacy-loss random variables no longer apply. As a result, it has remained unclear when meaningful composition guarantees can be obtained for quantum differential privacy (QDP).
  In this work, we clarify both the limitations and possibilities of composition in the quantum setting. We first show that classical-style composition fails in full generality for POVM-based approximate QDP: even quantum channels that are individually perfectly private can completely lose privacy when combined through correlated joint implementations. We then identify a setting in which clean composition guarantees can be restored. For tensor-product channels acting on product neighboring inputs, we introduce a quantum moments accountant based on an operator-valued notion of privacy loss and a matrix moment-generating function. Although the resulting Rényi-type divergence does not satisfy a data-processing inequality, we prove that controlling its moments suffices to bound measured Rényi divergence, yielding operational privacy guarantees against arbitrary measurements. This leads to advanced-composition-style bounds with the same leading-order behavior as in the classical theory.
  Our results demonstrate that meaningful composition theorems for quantum differential privacy require carefully articulated structural assumptions on channels, inputs, and adversarial measurements, and provide a principled framework for understanding which classical ideas do and do not extend to the quantum setting.

AI.title_translation: 量子差分隐私何时可以组合？
AI.tldr: 经典差分隐私的组合定理在量子差分隐私（QDP）中一般不成立。本文证明了只有在张量积信道和乘积输入等特定结构假设下，才能通过引入量子矩会计恢复具有与经典理论相同效率的高级组合保证。
AI.motivation: 经典差分隐私的组合性是其基石，但由于量子差分隐私（QDP）是针对任意测量的操作性定义，经典的基于标量隐私损失随机变量的组合论证不再适用。因此，QDP 何时能获得有意义的组合保证尚不清楚。
AI.method: 首先证明了基于 POVM 的近似 QDP 在一般情况下无法实现经典风格的组合。然后，针对作用于乘积邻近输入的张量积信道，引入了一种基于算子值隐私损失概念和矩阵矩生成函数的量子矩会计方法。
AI.result: 证明了即使是单独完全隐私的量子信道，在通过相关联合实现组合时也可能完全失去隐私。在特定结构假设下，控制量子矩会计的矩足以限制测量的 Rényi 散度，从而产生针对任意测量的操作性隐私保证，其高级组合界限与经典理论具有相同的主导阶行为。
AI.conclusion: 量子差分隐私要有意义的组合定理，需要对信道、输入和对抗性测量做出精心阐述的结构性假设。本文提供了一个理解哪些经典思想可以或不能扩展到量子环境的原则性框架。
AI.translation:
组合性是经典差分隐私的基石，通过组合定理（例如，基本和高级组合）为复杂算法提供了强大的端到端保证。然而，在量子环境中，隐私是针对任意测量的操作性定义，基于标量隐私损失随机变量的经典组合论证不再适用。因此，量子差分隐私（QDP）何时能获得有意义的组合保证一直不清楚。
在这项工作中，我们阐明了量子环境中组合性的局限性和可能性。我们首先证明了经典风格的组合在基于 POVM 的近似 QDP 的完全一般性中是失败的：即使是单独完全私密的量子信道，在通过相关联合实现组合时也可能完全失去隐私。然后，我们确定了一种可以恢复清晰组合保证的环境。对于作用于乘积邻近输入的张量积信道，我们引入了一种基于算子值隐私损失概念和矩阵矩生成函数的量子矩会计。尽管由此产生的 Rényi 型散度不满足数据处理不等式，但我们证明了控制其矩足以限制测量的 Rényi 散度，从而产生针对任意测量的操作性隐私保证。这导出了与经典理论具有相同主导阶行为的高级组合式界限。
我们的结果表明，量子差分隐私要有意义的组合定理，需要对信道、输入和对抗性测量做出精心阐述的结构性假设，并提供了一个理解哪些经典思想可以或不能扩展到量子环境的原则性框架。
AI.summary: 经典差分隐私中的组合性在量子差分隐私（QDP）的一般情况下失败，因为即使是完全私密的量子信道在相关联合实现中也会失去隐私。本文通过识别张量积信道作用于乘积邻近输入这一特定结构，恢复了组合保证。研究引入了一种基于算子值隐私损失的量子矩会计方法，并证明控制其矩可以导出针对任意测量的操作性隐私保证，其高级组合界限与经典理论具有相同的主导阶行为。
AI.keywords: 量子差分隐私, 组合性, 量子矩会计, 张量积信道, 隐私损失
AI.comments: 这篇论文解决了量子差分隐私（QDP）领域的一个核心挑战：组合性。其创新点在于：1) 明确指出了 QDP 组合性的局限性，证明了经典方法在一般情况下会失效（即使是完全私密的信道也会在联合实现中泄露隐私）。2) 提出了一个具体的解决方案，即通过结构化假设（张量积信道和乘积输入）恢复组合性。3) 引入了基于算子值隐私损失的“量子矩会计”这一新的技术工具，成功地将经典的高级组合界限（具有相同的渐近行为）推广到了量子设置。这对于构建复杂的、具有隐私保护的量子算法至关重要，为 QDP 理论的发展提供了原则性的框架。

title: Solving nonlinear subsonic compressible flow in infinite domain via multi-stage neural networks
summary: In aerodynamics, accurately modeling subsonic compressible flow over airfoils is critical for aircraft design. However, solving the governing nonlinear perturbation velocity potential equation presents computational challenges. Traditional approaches often rely on linearized equations or finite, truncated domains, which introduce non-negligible errors and limit applicability in real-world scenarios. In this study, we propose a novel framework utilizing Physics-Informed Neural Networks (PINNs) to solve the full nonlinear compressible potential equation in an unbounded (infinite) domain. We address the unbounded-domain and convergence challenges inherent in standard PINNs by incorporating a coordinate transformation and embedding physical asymptotic constraints directly into the network architecture. Furthermore, we employ a Multi-Stage PINN (MS-PINN) approach to iteratively minimize residuals, achieving solution accuracy approaching machine precision. We validate this framework by simulating flow over circular and elliptical geometries, comparing our results against traditional finite-domain and linearized solutions. Our findings quantify the noticeable discrepancies introduced by domain truncation and linearization, particularly at higher Mach numbers, and demonstrate that this new framework is a robust, high-fidelity tool for computational fluid dynamics.

AI.title_translation: 通过多阶段神经网络求解无限域中的非线性亚音速可压缩流
AI.tldr: 研究人员使用一种改进的物理信息神经网络（MS-PINN，结合了坐标变换和物理约束）成功地在无限域中高精度地求解了复杂的非线性可压缩空气流动问题，解决了传统方法的局限性。
AI.motivation: 在空气动力学中，准确模拟机翼上方的亚音速可压缩流对于飞机设计至关重要，但求解控制的非线性扰动速度势方程带来了计算挑战，传统方法依赖线性化方程或有限、截断的域，引入了不可忽略的误差。
AI.method: 提出了一种利用物理信息神经网络 (PINN) 解决全非线性可压缩势方程的框架。通过引入坐标变换和将物理渐近约束嵌入网络结构来解决无界域和收敛性挑战。采用多阶段PINN (MS-PINN) 方法迭代最小化残差。
AI.result: 通过模拟圆形和椭圆形几何体上的流动，并将结果与传统的有限域和线性化解进行比较，证明了该框架的有效性。该方法实现了接近机器精度的解精度。
AI.conclusion: 该新框架是一种稳健、高保真度的计算流体力学工具，它量化了由域截断和线性化引入的明显差异，尤其是在较高马赫数下。
AI.translation: 在空气动力学中，准确模拟机翼上方的亚音速可压缩流对于飞机设计至关重要。然而，求解控制的非线性扰动速度势方程带来了计算挑战。传统方法通常依赖线性化方程或有限、截断的域，这引入了不可忽略的误差并限制了在现实场景中的适用性。在这项研究中，我们提出了一个利用物理信息神经网络 (PINN) 在无界（无限）域中求解全非线性可压缩势方程的新颖框架。我们通过引入坐标变换并将物理渐近约束直接嵌入网络结构，解决了标准 PINN 中固有的无界域和收敛性挑战。此外，我们采用多阶段 PINN (MS-PINN) 方法迭代最小化残差，实现了接近机器精度的解精度。我们通过模拟圆形和椭圆形几何体上的流动来验证该框架，并将我们的结果与传统的有限域和线性化解进行比较。我们的研究结果量化了域截断和线性化引入的明显差异，尤其是在较高马赫数下，并证明了这一新框架是计算流体力学中一种稳健、高保真度的工具。
AI.summary: 本研究提出了一种新颖的基于物理信息神经网络 (PINN) 的框架，用于在无限域中求解全非线性亚音速可压缩流动。通过坐标变换和嵌入物理渐近约束，并采用多阶段 (MS-PINN) 迭代，该方法克服了标准 PINN 在无界域求解中的挑战，实现了高精度解，并量化了传统有限域和线性化方法的误差。
AI.keywords: 非线性可压缩流, 无限域, 物理信息神经网络 (PINN), 多阶段神经网络 (MS-PINN), 扰动速度势方程
AI.comments: 该方法创新性地结合了坐标变换和物理渐近约束来解决PINN在无限域求解中的挑战，并通过多阶段迭代提高了精度。其局限性可能在于多阶段训练的计算成本和超参数敏感性。该工作对计算流体力学（CFD）的无边界求解具有重要意义。

title: The Impact of Lesion Focus on the Performance of AI-Based Melanoma Classification
summary: Melanoma is the most lethal subtype of skin cancer, and early and accurate detection of this disease can greatly improve patients' outcomes. Although machine learning models, especially convolutional neural networks (CNNs), have shown great potential in automating melanoma classification, their diagnostic reliability still suffers due to inconsistent focus on lesion areas. In this study, we analyze the relationship between lesion attention and diagnostic performance, involving masked images, bounding box detection, and transfer learning. We used multiple explainability and sensitivity analysis approaches to investigate how well models aligned their attention with lesion areas and how this alignment correlated with precision, recall, and F1-score. Results showed that models with a higher focus on lesion areas achieved better diagnostic performance, suggesting the potential of interpretable AI in medical diagnostics. This study provides a foundation for developing more accurate and trustworthy melanoma classification models in the future.

AI.title_translation: 病灶焦点对基于AI的黑色素瘤分类性能的影响
AI.tldr: AI模型对黑色素瘤病灶的关注度越高，分类越准确。研究利用多种技术分析了这种相关性，证明了关注度对性能的关键影响，为开发更可靠的医疗AI奠定了基础。
AI.motivation: 尽管机器学习模型（特别是CNN）在自动化黑色素瘤分类方面显示出潜力，但其诊断可靠性仍因对病灶区域的关注不一致而受到影响，因此需要分析病灶注意力与诊断性能之间的关系。
AI.method: 分析了病灶注意力与诊断性能的关系，使用了掩膜图像、边界框检测和迁移学习，并采用了多种可解释性和敏感性分析方法来研究模型注意力与诊断指标（精确率、召回率和F1分数）的相关性。
AI.result: 结果表明，对病灶区域关注度更高的模型取得了更好的诊断性能。
AI.conclusion: 模型对病灶区域的关注度越高，其诊断性能越好，这为未来开发更准确、更值得信赖的黑色素瘤分类模型奠定了基础，并突显了可解释人工智能在医疗诊断中的潜力。
AI.translation: 黑色素瘤是皮肤癌中最致命的亚型，早期和准确的检测可以极大地改善患者的预后。尽管机器学习模型，特别是卷积神经网络（CNN），在自动化黑色素瘤分类方面显示出巨大潜力，但由于其对病灶区域的关注不一致，其诊断可靠性仍然受到影响。在本研究中，我们分析了病灶注意力与诊断性能之间的关系，涉及掩膜图像、边界框检测和迁移学习。我们使用多种可解释性和敏感性分析方法来研究模型将注意力与病灶区域对齐的程度，以及这种对齐与精确率、召回率和F1分数的相关性。结果表明，对病灶区域关注度更高的模型取得了更好的诊断性能，这表明了可解释人工智能在医疗诊断中的潜力。本研究为未来开发更准确、更值得信赖的黑色素瘤分类模型奠定了基础。
AI.summary: 本研究旨在探究AI（特别是CNN）在黑色素瘤分类中对病灶区域的关注度与诊断性能（精确率、召回率、F1分数）之间的关系。研究通过使用掩膜图像、边界框检测和迁移学习，并结合可解释性和敏感性分析方法，发现模型对病灶的关注度越高，其分类性能越优越，从而为未来开发更可靠的医疗AI模型提供了依据。
AI.keywords: 黑色素瘤分类, 卷积神经网络, 病灶关注度, 诊断性能, 可解释AI
AI.comments: 这项研究的创新之处在于系统地分析了AI模型对病灶区域的关注度（注意力）与诊断性能之间的关系，并使用了多种可解释性和敏感性分析方法来验证这一点。其重要性在于为构建更可靠和可信赖的AI皮肤癌分类模型指明了方向。局限性在于仅关注了病灶焦点，可能忽略了其他影响因素。

title: On the Largest Convexity Number of Co-Finite Sets in the Plane
summary: The convexity number of a set $X \subset \mathbb{R}^2$ is the minimum number of convex subsets required to cover it. We study the following question: what is the largest possible convexity number $f(n)$ of $\mathbb{R}^2 \setminus S$, where $S$ is a set of $n$ points in general position in the plane? We prove that for all $n \geq 4$, $\lfloor\frac{n+5}{2}\rfloor \leq f(n) \leq \frac{7n+44}{11}$. We also show that for every $n \geq 4$, if the points of $S$ are in convex position then the convexity number of $\mathbb{R}^2 \setminus S$ is $\lfloor\frac{n+5}{2}\rfloor$. This solves a problem of Lawrence and Morris [Finite sets as complements of finite unions of convex sets, Disc. Comput. Geom. 42 (2009), 206-218].

AI.title_translation: 关于平面上共有限集的最大凸性数
AI.tldr: 研究了从平面中移除 $n$ 个点后，剩余区域（共有限集）所需的最小凸覆盖数（凸性数）的最大值 $f(n)$ 的范围，并对点集呈凸排布的情况给出了精确解。
AI.motivation: 研究平面上移除有限点集后，剩余共有限集的最小凸覆盖所需的凸子集数量（即凸性数）的最大可能值，旨在解决 Lawrence 和 Morris 提出的问题。
AI.method: 通过研究 $n$ 个点的集合 $S$ 在平面 $\mathbb{R}^2$ 上的移除后剩余集合 $\mathbb{R}^2 \setminus S$ 的凸性数，推导出其上下界。对于 $S$ 在凸位置的情况，直接确定了精确值。
AI.result: 证明了对于所有 $n \geq 4$， $\lfloor\frac{n+5}{2}\rfloor \leq f(n) \leq \frac{7n+44}{11}$。此外，证明了如果 $S$ 中的点位于凸位置，则 $\mathbb{R}^2 \setminus S$ 的凸性数为 $\lfloor\frac{n+5}{2}\rfloor$。
AI.conclusion: 对于 $n \geq 4$，移除了 $n$ 个点后剩余集合的凸性数 $f(n)$ 满足 $\lfloor\frac{n+5}{2}\rfloor \leq f(n) \leq \frac{7n+44}{11}$。当 $S$ 中的点位于凸位置时，凸性数精确为 $\lfloor\frac{n+5}{2}\rfloor$。
AI.translation: 我们研究以下问题：在平面上，移除 $n$ 个点集 $S$ 后，剩余集合 $\mathbb{R}^2 \setminus S$ 的最大可能凸性数 $f(n)$ 是多少？我们证明了对于所有 $n \geq 4$， $\lfloor\frac{n+5}{2}\rfloor \leq f(n) \leq \frac{7n+44}{11}$。我们还证明了对于任何 $n \geq 4$，如果 $S$ 中的点位于凸位置，则 $\mathbb{R}^2 \setminus S$ 的凸性数为 $\lfloor\frac{n+5}{2}\rfloor$。这解决了 Lawrence 和 Morris 的一个问题。
AI.summary: 该研究确定了从平面中移除 $n$ 个点（$S$）后，剩余共有限集 $\mathbb{R}^2 \setminus S$ 的最大可能凸性数 $f(n)$ 的上下界，即 $\lfloor\frac{n+5}{2}\rfloor \leq f(n) \leq \frac{7n+44}{11}$ (对于 $n \geq 4$)。并且，当 $S$ 中的点构成凸包时，凸性数精确为 $\lfloor\frac{n+5}{2}\rfloor$，从而解决了 Lawrence 和 Morris 的一个问题。
AI.keywords: 凸性数, 共有限集, 平面, 点集, 凸包
AI.comments: 该论文的主要创新在于确定了移除平面上 $n$ 个点后，剩余共有限集（co-finite set）的凸性数的上下界，并对点集位于凸位置的特殊情况给出了精确解，解决了先前研究中的一个问题。其重要性在于为几何覆盖问题提供了更精确的理论界限。局限性在于上界和下界之间仍存在差距，且仅考虑了一般位置和凸位置的点集。

title: A Deep Learning-Enhanced Fourier Method for the Multi-Frequency Inverse Source Problem with Sparse Far-Field Data
summary: This paper introduces a hybrid computational framework for the multi-frequency inverse source problem governed by the Helmholtz equation. By integrating a classical Fourier method with a deep convolutional neural network, we address the challenges inherent in sparse and noisy far-field data. The Fourier method provides a physics-informed, low-frequency approximation of the source, which serves as the input to a U-Net. The network is trained to map this coarse approximation to a high-fidelity source reconstruction, effectively suppressing truncation artifacts and recovering fine-scale geometric details. To enhance computational efficiency and robustness, we propose a high-to-low noise transfer learning strategy: a model pre-trained on high-noise regimes captures global topological features, offering a robust initialization for fine-tuning on lower-noise data. Numerical experiments demonstrate that the framework achieves accurate reconstructions with noise levels up to 100%, significantly outperforms traditional spectral methods under sparse measurement constraints, and generalizes well to unseen source geometries.

AI.title_translation: 一种增强深度学习的傅里叶方法用于稀疏远场数据下的多频反源问题
AI.tldr: 通过将傅里叶方法的物理近似输入到U-Net中，并使用特殊的噪声迁移学习策略，该深度学习增强的傅里叶方法能够从极其稀疏和嘈杂的远场数据中准确地重建多频源，性能优于传统方法。
AI.motivation: 解决受亥姆霍兹方程控制的多频反问题中，由稀疏和噪声远场数据带来的挑战。
AI.method: 将经典的傅里叶方法与深度卷积神经网络（U-Net）相结合。傅里叶方法提供物理信息、低频源近似作为U-Net的输入，网络学习将粗糙近似映射到高保真源重建。引入高到低噪声的迁移学习策略，先在强噪声数据上预训练以捕获全局拓扑特征，再在低噪声数据上微调。
AI.result: 该框架在高达100%的噪声水平下实现了准确重建，显著优于传统谱方法，并能很好地泛化到新的源几何形状。
AI.conclusion: 该混合框架在高达100%的噪声水平下实现了准确的重建，显著优于稀疏测量约束下的传统谱方法，并且能很好地泛化到未见过的源几何形状。
AI.translation: 本文介绍了一种用于多频反源问题的混合计算框架，该问题受亥姆霍兹方程控制。通过将经典傅里叶方法与深度卷积神经网络相结合，我们解决了稀疏和噪声远场数据中固有的挑战。傅里叶方法提供了源的物理信息、低频近似，作为U-Net的输入。该网络经过训练，可将这种粗略的近似映射到高保真源重建，有效抑制截断伪影并恢复精细尺度的几何细节。为了提高计算效率和鲁棒性，我们提出了一种高到低噪声的迁移学习策略：在强噪声环境下预训练的模型捕获全局拓扑特征，为在低噪声数据上进行微调提供了稳健的初始化。数值实验表明，该框架在高达100%的噪声水平下实现了准确的重建，在稀疏测量约束下显著优于传统谱方法，并且能很好地泛化到未见过的源几何形状。
AI.summary: 本文提出了一种混合计算框架，用于解决多频逆源问题，该框架结合了经典傅里叶方法和U-Net深度学习模型，以应对稀疏和噪声数据。傅里叶方法提供物理约束的低频输入，网络学习生成高保真重建，有效抑制截断伪影。此外，采用高到低噪声的迁移学习策略以提高效率和鲁棒性。
AI.keywords: 多频反问题, 傅里叶方法, 深度学习, 稀疏数据, 迁移学习
AI.comments: 该方法创新性地结合了经典的傅里叶方法（提供物理约束的低频近似）和深度学习（U-Net）来解决稀疏数据下的多频反问题。其提出的高到低噪声的迁移学习策略增强了模型的鲁棒性和效率，使其在极端稀疏和高噪声条件下表现出色，这是其重要性所在。限制在于其性能依赖于所选的傅里叶方法提供的初始近似质量。

title: Quadratic Unconstrained Binary Optimisation for Training and Regularisation of Binary Neural Networks
summary: Advances in artificial intelligence (AI) and deep learning have raised concerns about its increasing energy consumption, while demand for deploying AI in mobile devices and machines at the edge is growing. Binary neural networks (BNNs) have recently gained attention as energy and memory efficient models suitable for resource constrained environments; however, training BNNs exactly is computationally challenging because of its discrete characteristics. Recent work proposing a framework for training BNNs based on quadratic unconstrained binary optimisation (QUBO) and progress in the design of Ising machines for solving QUBO problems suggest a potential path to efficiently optimising discrete neural networks. In this work, we extend existing QUBO models for training BNNs to accommodate arbitrary network topologies and propose two novel methods for regularisation. The first method maximises neuron margins biasing the training process toward parameter configurations that yield larger pre-activation magnitudes. The second method employs a dropout-inspired iterative scheme in which reduced subnetworks are trained and used to adjust linear penalties on network parameters. We apply the proposed QUBO formulation to a small binary image classification problem and conduct computational experiments on a GPU-based Ising machine. The numerical results indicate that the proposed regularisation terms modify training behaviour and yield improvements in classification accuracy on data not present in the training set.

title: MIMO-AFDM Outperforms MIMO-OFDM in the Face of Hardware Impairments
comments: 13 pages, 11 figures, submitted to IEEE TCOM
summary: The impact of both multiplicative and additive hardware impairments (HWIs) on multiple-input multiple-output affine frequency division multiplexing (MIMO-AFDM) systems is investigated. For small-scale MIMO-AFDM systems, a tight bit error rate (BER) upper bound associated with the maximum likelihood (ML) detector is derived. By contrast, for large-scale systems, a closed-form BER approximation associated with the linear minimum mean squared error (LMMSE) detector is presented, including realistic imperfect channel estimation scenarios. Our first key observation is that the full diversity order of a hardware-impaired AFDM system remains unaffected, which is a unique advantage. Furthermore, our analysis shows that 1) the BER results derived accurately predict the simulated ML performance in moderate-to-high signal-to-noise ratios (SNRs), while the theoretical BER curve of the LMMSE detector closely matches that of the Monte-Carlo based one. 2) MIMO-AFDM is more resilient to multiplicative distortions, such as phase noise and carrier frequency offset, compared to its orthogonal frequency division multiplexing (OFDM) counterparts. This is attributed to its inherent chirp signal characteristics; 3) MIMO-AFDM consistently achieves superior BER performance compared to conventional MIMO-OFDM systems under the same additive HWI conditions, as well as different velocity values. The latter is because MIMO-AFDM is also resilient to the additional inter-carrier interference (ICI) imposed by the nonlinear distortions of additive HWIs. In a nutshell, compared to OFDM, AFDM demonstrates stronger ICI resilience and achieves the maximum full diversity attainable gain even under HWIs, thanks to its intrinsic chirp signalling structure as well as to the beneficial spreading effect of the discrete affine Fourier transform.
comment: 13 pages, 11 figures, submitted to IEEE TCOM

title: Interpretable Machine Learning for Quantum-Informed Property Predictions in Artificial Sensing Materials
summary: Digital sensing faces challenges in developing sustainable methods to extend the applicability of customized e-noses to complex body odor volatilome (BOV). To address this challenge, we developed MORE-ML, a computational framework that integrates quantum-mechanical (QM) property data of e-nose molecular building blocks with machine learning (ML) methods to predict sensing-relevant properties. Within this framework, we expanded our previous dataset, MORE-Q, to MORE-QX by sampling a larger conformational space of interactions between BOV molecules and mucin-derived receptors. This dataset provides extensive electronic binding features (BFs) computed upon BOV adsorption. Analysis of MORE-QX property space revealed weak correlations between QM properties of building blocks and resulting BFs. Leveraging this observation, we defined electronic descriptors of building blocks as inputs for tree-based ML models to predict BFs. Benchmarking showed CatBoost models outperform alternatives, especially in transferability to unseen compounds. Explainable AI methods further highlighted which QM properties most influence BF predictions. Collectively, MORE-ML combines QM insights with ML to provide mechanistic understanding and rational design principles for molecular receptors in BOV sensing. This approach establishes a foundation for advancing artificial sensing materials capable of analyzing complex odor mixtures, bridging the gap between molecular-level computations and practical e-nose applications.

title: Generative Conditional Missing Imputation Networks
summary: In this study, we introduce a sophisticated generative conditional strategy designed to impute missing values within datasets, an area of considerable importance in statistical analysis. Specifically, we initially elucidate the theoretical underpinnings of the Generative Conditional Missing Imputation Networks (GCMI), demonstrating its robust properties in the context of the Missing Completely at Random (MCAR) and the Missing at Random (MAR) mechanisms. Subsequently, we enhance the robustness and accuracy of GCMI by integrating a multiple imputation framework using a chained equations approach. This innovation serves to bolster model stability and improve imputation performance significantly. Finally, through a series of meticulous simulations and empirical assessments utilizing benchmark datasets, we establish the superior efficacy of our proposed methods when juxtaposed with other leading imputation techniques currently available. This comprehensive evaluation not only underscores the practicality of GCMI but also affirms its potential as a leading-edge tool in the field of statistical data analysis.

title: Parametrized Sharing for Multi-Agent Hybrid DRL for Multiple Multi-Functional RISs-Aided Downlink NOMA Networks
summary: Multi-functional reconfigurable intelligent surface (MF-RIS) is conceived to address the communication efficiency thanks to its extended signal coverage from its active RIS capability and self-sustainability from energy harvesting (EH). We investigate the architecture of multi-MF-RISs to assist non-orthogonal multiple access (NOMA) downlink networks. We formulate an energy efficiency (EE) maximization problem by optimizing power allocation, transmit beamforming and MF-RIS configurations of amplitudes, phase-shifts and EH ratios, as well as the position of MF-RISs, while satisfying constraints of available power, user rate requirements, and self-sustainability property. We design a parametrized sharing scheme for multi-agent hybrid deep reinforcement learning (PMHRL), where the multi-agent proximal policy optimization (PPO) and deep-Q network (DQN) handle continuous and discrete variables, respectively. The simulation results have demonstrated that proposed PMHRL has the highest EE compared to other benchmarks, including cases without parametrized sharing, pure PPO and DQN. Moreover, the proposed multi-MF-RISs-aided downlink NOMA achieves the highest EE compared to scenarios of no-EH/amplification, traditional RISs, and deployment without RISs/MF-RISs under different multiple access.

title: AceFF: A State-of-the-Art Machine Learning Potential for Small Molecules
summary: We introduce AceFF, a pre-trained machine learning interatomic potential (MLIP) optimized for small molecule drug discovery. While MLIPs have emerged as efficient alternatives to Density Functional Theory (DFT), generalizability across diverse chemical spaces remains difficult. AceFF addresses this via a refined TensorNet2 architecture trained on a comprehensive dataset of drug-like compounds. This approach yields a force field that balances high-throughput inference speed with DFT-level accuracy. AceFF fully supports the essential medicinal chemistry elements (H, B, C, N, O, F, Si, P, S, Cl, Br, I) and is explicitly trained to handle charged states. Validation against rigorous benchmarks, including complex torsional energy scans, molecular dynamics trajectories, batched minimizations, and forces and anergy accuracy demonstrates that AceFF establishes a new state-of-the-art for organic molecules. The AceFF-2 model weights and inference code are available at https://huggingface.co/Acellera/AceFF-2.0.

title: Towards a conjecture on long induced rainbow paths in triangle-free graphs
summary: Given a triangle-free graph $G$ with chromatic number $k$ and a proper vertex coloring $φ$ of $G$, it is conjectured that $G$ contains an induced rainbow path on $k$ vertices under $φ$. Scott and Seymour proved the existence of an induced rainbow path on $(\log \log \log k)^{\frac{1}{3}- o(1)}$ vertices. We improve this to $(\log k)^{\frac{1}{2}- o(1)}$ vertices. Further, we prove the existence of an induced path that sees $\frac{k}{2}$ colors.

title: Splitting Precoding with Subspace Selection and Quantized Refinement for Massive MIMO
summary: Limited fronthaul capacity is a practical bottleneck in massive multiple-input multiple-output (MIMO) 5G architectures, where a base station (BS) consists of an advanced antenna system (AAS) connected to a baseband unit (BBU). Conventional downlink designs place the entire precoding computation at the BBU and transmit a high-dimensional precoding matrix over the fronthaul, resulting in substantial quantization losses and signaling overhead. This letter proposes a splitting precoding architecture that separates the design between the AAS and BBU. The AAS performs a local subspace selection to reduce the channel dimensionality, while the BBU computes an optimized quantized refinement precoding based on the resulting effective channel. The numerical results show that the proposed splitting precoding strategy achieves higher sum spectral efficiency than conventional one-stage precoding.

title: Quantum Simulation of Protein Fragment Electronic Structure Using Moment-based Adaptive Variational Quantum Algorithms
comments: Keywords: quantum computing, variational quantum eigensolver, protein fragments, electronic structure, drug discovery, enzyme engineering
summary:
Background: Understanding electronic interactions in protein active sites is fundamental to drug discovery and enzyme engineering, but remains computationally challenging due to exponential scaling of quantum mechanical calculations.
  Results: We present a quantum-classical hybrid framework for simulating protein fragment electronic structure using variational quantum algorithms. We construct fermionic Hamiltonians from experimentally determined protein structures, map them to qubits via Jordan-Wigner transformation, and optimize ground state energies using the Variational Quantum Eigensolver implemented in pure Python. For a 4-orbital serine protease fragment, we achieve chemical accuracy (< 1.6 mHartree) with 95.3% correlation energy recovery. Systematic analysis reveals three-phase convergence behaviour with exponential decay (α = 0.95), power law optimization (γ = 1.21), and asymptotic approach. Application to SARS-CoV-2 protease inhibition demonstrates predictive accuracy (MAE=0.25 kcal/mol), while cytochrome P450 metabolism predictions achieve 85% site accuracy.
  Conclusions: This work establishes a pathway for quantum-enhanced biomolecular simulations on near-term quantum hardware, bridging quantum algorithm development with practical biological applications.

title: Assessing Quantum Annealing to Solve the Minimum Vertex Multicut
summary: Cybersecurity in telecommunication networks often leads to hard combinatorial optimization problems that are challenging to solve with classical methods. This work investigates the practical feasibility of using quantum annealing to address the Restricted Vertex Minimum Multicut Problem. The problem is formulated as a Quadratic Unconstrained Binary Optimization model and implemented on D-Wave s quantum annealer. Rather than focusing on solution quality alone, we analyze key aspects of the quantum workflow including minor embedding techniques, chain length, topology constraints, chain strength selection, unembedding procedures, and postprocessing. Our results show that quantum annealing faces substantial hardware-level constraints limitations in embedding and scalability, especially for large instances, while hybrid quantum-classical solvers provide improved feasibility. This study offers a realistic assessment of the D-Wave system s current capabilities and identifies crucial parameters that govern the success of quantum optimization in cybersecurity-related network problems.

title: Quantum Approaches to the Minimum Edge Multiway Cut Problem
summary: We investigate the minimum edge multiway cut problem, a fundamental task in evaluating the resilience of telecommunication networks. This study benchmarks the problem across three quantum computing paradigms: quantum annealing on a D-Wave quantum processing unit, photonic variational quantum circuits simulated on Quandela s Perceval platform, and IBM s gate-based Quantum Approximate Optimization Algorithm (QAOA). We assess the comparative feasibility of these approaches for early-stage quantum optimization, highlighting trade-offs in circuit constraints, encoding overhead, and scalability. Our findings suggest that quantum annealing currently offers the most scalable performance for this class of problems, while photonic and gate-based approaches remain limited by hardware and simulation depth. These results provide actionable insights for designing quantum workflows targeting combinatorial optimization in telecom security and resilience analysis.

title: Three results on twisted $G-$codes and skew twisted $G-$codes
summary: In this paper we solve an open question formulated in the original paper of twisted skew group codes regarding when a twisted skew group code is checkable. Also, we prove that all ideals of dimension 3 over a twisted group algebra are abelian group codes, generalising another previous result over group algebras. Finally, we prove a bound on the dimension and distance of a twisted group code, as well as when such bound is reached.

title: Modeling Epidemic Dynamics of Mutant Strains with Evolutionary Game-based Vaccination Behavior
summary: The outbreak of mutant strains and vaccination behaviors have been the focus of recent epidemiological research, but most existing epidemic models failed to simultaneously capture viral mutation and consider the complexity and behavioral dynamics of vaccination. To address this gap, we develop an extended SIRS model that distinguishes infections with the original strain and a mutant strain, and explicitly introduces a vaccinated compartment state. At the behavioral level, we employ evolutionary game theory to model individual vaccination decisions, where strategies are determined by both neighbors' choices and the current epidemiological situation. This process corresponds to the time-varying vaccination rate of susceptible individuals transitioning to vaccinated individuals at the epidemic spreading level. We then couple the epidemic and vaccination behavioral processes through the microscopic Markov chain approach (MMCA) and finally investigate the evolutionary dynamics via numerical simulations. The results show that our framework can effectively mitigate outbreaks across different disease scenarios. Sensitivity analysis further reveals that vaccination uptake is most strongly influenced by vaccine cost, efficacy, and perceived risk of side effects. Overall, this behavior-aware modeling framework captures the co-evolution of viral mutation and vaccination behavior, providing quantitative and theoretical support for designing effective public health vaccination policies.

title: Density-Based Algorithms for Corruption-Robust Contextual Search and Convex Optimization
comments: Extended abstract accepted at COLT22. This is a significantly updated version
summary:
We study the problem of contextual search, a generalization of binary search in higher dimensions, in the adversarial noise model. Let $d$ be the dimension of the problem, $T$ be the time horizon and $C$ be the total amount of adversarial noise in the system. We focus on the $ε$-ball and the symmetric loss. For the $ε$-ball loss, we give a tight regret bound of $O(C + d \log(1/ε))$ improving over the $O(d^3 \log(1/ε) \log^2(T) + C \log(T) \log(1/ε))$ bound of Krishnamurthy et al (Operations Research '23). For the symmetric loss, we give an efficient algorithm with regret $O(C+d \log T)$. To tackle the symmetric loss case, we study the more general setting of Corruption-Robust Convex Optimization with Subgradient feedback, which is of independent interest.
  Our techniques are a significant departure from prior approaches. Specifically, we keep track of density functions over the candidate target vectors instead of a knowledge set consisting of the candidate target vectors consistent with the feedback obtained.

title: Dynamic Gap: Safe Gap-based Navigation in Dynamic Environments
comments: Accepted to 2025 International Conference on Robotics and Automation (ICRA)
summary: This paper extends the family of gap-based local planners to unknown dynamic environments through generating provable collision-free properties for hierarchical navigation systems. Existing perception-informed local planners that operate in dynamic environments rely on emergent or empirical robustness for collision avoidance as opposed to performing formal analysis of dynamic obstacles. In addition to this, the obstacle tracking that is performed in these existent planners is often achieved with respect to a global inertial frame, subjecting such tracking estimates to transformation errors from odometry drift. The proposed local planner, dynamic gap, shifts the tracking paradigm to modeling how the free space, represented as gaps, evolves over time. Gap crossing and closing conditions are developed to aid in determining the feasibility of passage through gaps, and a breadth of simulation benchmarking is performed against other navigation planners in the literature where the proposed dynamic gap planner achieves the highest success rate out of all planners tested in all environments.
comment: Accepted to 2025 International Conference on Robotics and Automation (ICRA)

title: DMH-HARQ: Reliable and Open Latency-Constrained Wireless Transport Network
comments: To appear in IEEE Transactions on Networking
summary:
The extreme requirements for high reliability and low latency in the upcoming Sixth Generation (6G) wireless networks are challenging the design of multi-hop wireless transport networks. Inspired by the advent of the virtualization concept in the wireless networks design and openness paradigm as fostered by the Open-Radio Access Network (O-RAN) Alliance, we target a revolutionary resource allocation scheme to improve the overall transmission efficiency.
  In this paper, we investigate the problem of automatic repeat request (ARQ) in multi-hop decode-and-forward (DF) relaying in the finite blocklength (FBL) regime, and propose a dynamic scheme of multi-hop hybrid ARQ (HARQ), which maximizes the end-to-end (E2E) communication reliability in the wireless transport network. We also propose an integer dynamic programming (DP) algorithm to efficiently solve the optimal Dynamic Multi-Hop HARQ (DMH-HARQ) strategy. Constrained within a certain time frame to accomplish E2E transmission, our proposed approach is proven to outperform the conventional listening-based cooperative ARQ, as well as any static HARQ strategy, regarding the E2E reliability. It is applicable without dependence on special delay constraint, and is particularly competitive for long-distance transport network with many hops.
comment: To appear in IEEE Transactions on Networking

title: Distributed Sparse Linear Regression under Communication Constraints
summary: In multiple domains, statistical tasks are performed in distributed settings, with data split among several end machines that are connected to a fusion center. In various applications, the end machines have limited bandwidth and power, and thus a tight communication budget. In this work we focus on distributed learning of a sparse linear regression model, under severe communication constraints. We propose several two round distributed schemes, whose communication per machine is sublinear in the data dimension. In our schemes, individual machines compute debiased lasso estimators, but send to the fusion center only very few values. On the theoretical front, we analyze one of these schemes and prove that with high probability it achieves exact support recovery at low signal to noise ratios, where individual machines fail to recover the support. We show in simulations that our scheme works as well as, and in some cases better, than more communication intensive approaches.

title: Efficient Multi-Task Scene Analysis with RGB-D Transformers
comments: Published in Proc. International Joint Conference on Neural Networks (IJCNN 2023)
summary: Scene analysis is essential for enabling autonomous systems, such as mobile robots, to operate in real-world environments. However, obtaining a comprehensive understanding of the scene requires solving multiple tasks, such as panoptic segmentation, instance orientation estimation, and scene classification. Solving these tasks given limited computing and battery capabilities on mobile platforms is challenging. To address this challenge, we introduce an efficient multi-task scene analysis approach, called EMSAFormer, that uses an RGB-D Transformer-based encoder to simultaneously perform the aforementioned tasks. Our approach builds upon the previously published EMSANet. However, we show that the dual CNN-based encoder of EMSANet can be replaced with a single Transformer-based encoder. To achieve this, we investigate how information from both RGB and depth data can be effectively incorporated in a single encoder. To accelerate inference on robotic hardware, we provide a custom NVIDIA TensorRT extension enabling highly optimization for our EMSAFormer approach. Through extensive experiments on the commonly used indoor datasets NYUv2, SUNRGB-D, and ScanNet, we show that our approach achieves state-of-the-art performance while still enabling inference with up to 39.1 FPS on an NVIDIA Jetson AGX Orin 32 GB.

title: Stochastic dual coordinate descent with adaptive heavy ball momentum for linearly constrained convex optimization
comments: To appear in Numerische Mathematik. arXiv admin note: text overlap with arXiv:2305.05482
summary: The problem of finding a solution to the linear system $Ax = b$ with certain minimization properties arises in numerous scientific and engineering areas. In the era of big data, the stochastic optimization algorithms become increasingly significant due to their scalability for problems of unprecedented size. This paper focuses on the problem of minimizing a strongly convex function subject to linear constraints. We consider the dual formulation of this problem and adopt the stochastic coordinate descent to solve it. The proposed algorithmic framework, called adaptive stochastic dual coordinate descent, utilizes sampling matrices sampled from user-defined distributions to extract gradient information. Moreover, it employs Polyak's heavy ball momentum acceleration with adaptive parameters learned through iterations, overcoming the limitation of the heavy ball momentum method that it requires prior knowledge of certain parameters, such as the singular values of a matrix. With these extensions, the framework is able to recover many well-known methods in the context, including the randomized sparse Kaczmarz method, the randomized regularized Kaczmarz method, the linearized Bregman iteration, and a variant of the conjugate gradient (CG) method. Additionally, we introduce an equivalent formulation that, in certain cases, substantially reduces the need for full-dimensional vector operations introduced by the momentum term. We prove that, with strongly admissible objective function, the proposed method converges linearly in expectation. Numerical experiments are provided to confirm our results.

title: Preconditioning for time-harmonic Maxwell's equations using the Laguerre transform
summary: A method of numerically solving the Maxwell equations is considered for modeling harmonic electromagnetic fields. The vector finite element method makes it possible to obtain a physically consistent discretization of the differential equations. However, solving large systems of linear algebraic equations with indefinite ill-conditioned matrices is a challenge. The high order of the matrices limits the capabilities of the Gaussian method to solve such systems, since this requires large RAM and much calculation. To reduce these requirements, an iterative preconditioned algorithm based on integral Laguerre transform in time is used. This approach allows using multigrid algorithms and, as a result, needs less RAM compared to the direct methods of solving systems of linear algebraic equations.

title: Understanding the Research-Practice Gap in Visualization Design Guidelines
summary: Although empirical research often underpins practical visualization guidelines, it remains unclear how well these research-driven insights are reflected in the guidelines practitioners actually use. In this paper, we investigate the research-practice gap in visualization design guidelines through a mixed-methods approach. We collected 390 design guidelines from practitioner-facing sources and 235 empirical studies to quantitatively assess their alignment. To complement this analysis, we conducted surveys with 69 participants (33 practitioners, 36 researchers) and in-depth interviews with 20 experts to examine their experiences, perceptions, and challenges. Our findings reveal discrepancies: empirical evidence often contradicts or only partially supports widely used guidelines, and the two communities prioritize different attributes of design. Based on these insights, we derive a holistic guideline template (integrating Context, Approach, Problem, and Purpose) and discuss actionable strategies, such as a triadic knowledge model.

title: Stability and Convergence of HDG Schemes under Minimal Regularity
summary: Convergence and compactness properties of approximate solutions to elliptic partial differential computed with the hybridized discontinuous Galerkin (HDG) are established. While it is known that solutions computed using the HDG scheme converge at optimal rates to smooth solutions, this does not establish the stability of the method or convergence to solutions with minimal regularity. The compactness and convergence results show that the HDG scheme can be utilized for the solution of nonlinear problems and linear problems with non-smooth coefficients on domains with reentrant corners.

title: Evolutionary Optimization of Physics-Informed Neural Networks: Advancing Generalizability by the Baldwin Effect
comments: Accepted for publication in IEEE Transactions on Evolutionary Computation
summary: Physics-informed neural networks (PINNs) are at the forefront of scientific machine learning, making possible the creation of machine intelligence that is cognizant of physical laws and able to accurately simulate them. However, today's PINNs are often trained for a single physics task and require computationally expensive re-training for each new task, even for tasks from similar physics domains. To address this limitation, this paper proposes a pioneering approach to advance the generalizability of PINNs through the framework of Baldwinian evolution. Drawing inspiration from the neurodevelopment of precocial species that have evolved to learn, predict and react quickly to their environment, we envision PINNs that are pre-wired with connection strengths inducing strong biases towards efficient learning of physics. A novel two-stage stochastic programming formulation coupling evolutionary selection pressure (based on proficiency over a distribution of physics tasks) with lifetime learning (to specialize on a sampled subset of those tasks) is proposed to instantiate the Baldwin effect. The evolved Baldwinian-PINNs demonstrate fast and physics-compliant prediction capabilities across a range of empirically challenging problem instances with more than an order of magnitude improvement in prediction accuracy at a fraction of the computation cost compared to state-of-the-art gradient-based meta-learning methods. For example, when solving the diffusion-reaction equation, a 70x improvement in accuracy was obtained while taking 700x less computational time. This paper thus marks a leap forward in the meta-learning of PINNs as generalizable physics solvers. Sample codes are available at https://github.com/chiuph/Baldwinian-PINN.

AI.title_translation: 物理信息神经网络的进化优化：通过鲍德温效应提升泛化能力
AI.tldr: 针对传统PINNs泛化性差的问题，本文提出了一种基于鲍德温效应（Baldwin Effect）的两阶段进化优化方法，通过预先设置连接强度（pre-wired biases）来加速学习，使得进化的PINNs（Baldwinian-PINNs）在计算成本大幅降低的同时，预测精度比现有元学习方法提高了十倍以上。

AI.summary: 本文旨在解决物理信息神经网络（PINNs）泛化性差、需重复训练的问题。受鲍德温效应启发，作者提出了一种创新的两阶段随机规划元学习框架，通过进化选择压力预先优化网络连接强度（引入强偏差），以促进PINNs的快速和高效学习。实验结果表明，这种进化的Baldwinian-PINNs在具有挑战性的物理任务上，相较于现有元学习方法，在计算效率大幅提高（例如减少700倍时间）的同时，预测精度提高了十倍以上。
AI.keywords: 物理信息神经网络, 鲍德温效应, 进化优化, 元学习, 泛化能力
AI.comments: 本文的创新点在于将生物进化中的鲍德温效应引入到科学机器学习的元学习框架中，用于优化PINNs的泛化能力。通过模拟“预先连接”的神经发育机制，该方法有效地实现了网络结构的内在偏差（intrinsic bias）优化，从而显著提高了PINNs在面对新任务时的学习速度和预测准确性。其重要性在于，它为创建高效、可泛化的物理求解器提供了新的范式，有望大幅降低科学仿真中模型适应新问题的计算成本。

title: Enthuse: Efficient Adaptable High-throughput Streaming Aggregation Engines
summary: Aggregation queries are a series of computationally-demanding analytics operations on counted, grouped or time series data. They include tasks such as summation or finding the median among the items of the same group, and within a specified number of the last observed tuples for sliding window aggregation (SWAG). They have a wide range of applications including database analytics, operating systems, bank security and medical sensors. Existing challenges include the hardware complexity that comes with efficiently handling per-group states using hash-based approaches. This paper presents Enthuse, an adaptable pipeline for calculating a wide range of aggregation queries with high throughput. It is then adapted for SWAG and achieves up to 476x speedup over the CPU core of the same platform. It achieves unparalleled levels of performance and functionality such as a throughput of 1 GT/s on our setup for SWAG without groups, and more advanced operators with up to 4x the window sizes than the state-of-the-art with groups as an approximation for SWAG featuring per-group windows using a fraction of the resources and no DRAM.

AI.title_translation: Enthuse：高效、可适应的高吞吐量流式聚合引擎
AI.tldr: Enthuse是一种高效、可适应的流式聚合管道，专为处理计算密集型聚合查询（尤其是滑动窗口聚合 SWAG）而设计。它解决了现有硬件处理分组状态的复杂性问题，在SWAG上实现了高达476倍于CPU的速度提升，并在无分组SWAG上实现了1 GT/s的吞吐量，且无需DRAM。

AI.method: 本文提出了Enthuse，这是一个可适应的管道（adaptable pipeline），用于计算各种具有高吞吐量的聚合查询。它随后被调整用于滑动窗口聚合（SWAG）。
AI.result: Enthuse在滑动窗口聚合（SWAG）上实现了高达476倍于同一平台CPU核的加速。在无分组SWAG设置中，实现了1 GT/s的吞吐量。对于更高级的操作符，作为带有分组的SWAG近似，它实现了比现有技术高出4倍的窗口大小，同时使用了极少量的资源且无需DRAM。
AI.translation: 聚合查询是一系列针对计数、分组或时间序列数据的计算密集型分析操作。它们包括对同一组项目求和或求中位数，以及在滑动窗口聚合（SWAG）中对指定数量的最后观测元组进行操作等任务。它们具有广泛的应用，包括数据库分析、操作系统、银行安全和医疗传感器。现有的挑战包括使用基于哈希的方法有效处理每组状态所带来的硬件复杂性。本文提出了Enthuse，这是一个可适应的管道，用于计算各种具有高吞吐量的聚合查询。它随后被调整用于SWAG，并在同一平台的CPU核上实现了高达476倍的加速。它实现了无与伦比的性能和功能水平，例如在我们的设置中，对于无分组的SWAG，吞吐量达到1 GT/s；对于更高级的操作符，作为带有分组的SWAG近似（具有每组窗口），它实现了比现有技术高出4倍的窗口大小，同时只使用了极少量的资源且无需DRAM。
AI.summary: Enthuse是一种针对计算密集型聚合查询（包括滑动窗口聚合SWAG）设计的高效可适应流式聚合引擎。它旨在克服现有哈希方法处理分组状态的硬件复杂性挑战。Enthuse作为一个可适应的管道，实现了高吞吐量，在SWAG上相对于CPU核实现了高达476倍的加速。此外，它在无分组SWAG上达到了1 GT/s的吞吐量，并能处理比现有技术大4倍的带有分组的窗口，同时显著减少了资源使用且不依赖DRAM。
AI.keywords: 流式聚合, 滑动窗口聚合 (SWAG), 高吞吐量, 可适应管道, Enthuse
AI.comments: 这篇论文的创新点在于提出了Enthuse，一个专为处理高吞吐量流式聚合查询（特别是滑动窗口聚合 SWAG）而设计的“可适应管道”。它直接解决了现有硬件在处理需要维护每组状态的聚合查询时，基于哈希方法的复杂性和效率瓶颈。文中报告的性能提升数据（高达476倍的CPU加速，1 GT/s的吞吐量）非常引人注目，尤其是在无需DRAM的情况下处理带有分组的复杂操作，显示了其在资源效率和绝对性能上的显著优势。这对于需要实时、低延迟分析的领域（如数据库分析、安全和传感器数据处理）具有重要意义。

title: Empirical Study on the Representation of 3D Scatterplots as 2D Figures
summary: 3D scatterplots are a well-established plotting technique that can be used to represent data with three or more dimensions. On paper and computer monitors they are essentially two-dimensional projections of the three-dimensional Cartesian coordinate system. This transition from the 3D space to two dimensions is not done consistently among scientific software, as there is currently limited quantifiable evidence on the effectiveness of each approach. Notably, the frequent lack of visual cues such as with regard to depth perception is equivalent to a reduction of dimensionality by one. Hence, their use in manuscripts is less common or straightforward. In this empirical study, an online survey is conducted within an academic institution to identify and quantify the effectiveness of feature or feature combinations on 3D scatterplots in terms of reading time and accuracy.

AI.title_translation: 三维散点图表示为二维图形的实证研究
AI.tldr: 研究人员进行了一项在线实证调查，旨在量化不同特征或特征组合在将三维散点图投影到二维时（如在论文或屏幕上）对阅读时间和准确性的影响，以解决现有科学软件表示不一致且缺乏量化证据的问题。
AI.motivation: 三维散点图在纸张和电脑显示器上本质上是三维坐标系的二维投影。然而，科学软件在实现这种二维投影时缺乏一致性，且目前缺乏关于各种方法有效性的量化证据。此外，经常缺乏深度感知等视觉线索，这相当于维度降低了一维，导致其在手稿中的使用不常见或不直接。
AI.method: 进行了一项实证研究，具体是在一家学术机构内进行了一次在线调查。目的是根据阅读时间和准确性，识别并量化三维散点图中特征或特征组合的有效性。
AI.translation: 三维散点图是一种成熟的绘图技术，可用于表示具有三个或更多维度的数据。在纸张和电脑显示器上，它们本质上是三维笛卡尔坐标系的二维投影。由于目前缺乏关于各种方法有效性的量化证据，科学软件在从三维空间到二维的这种转换方面做法不一致。值得注意的是，经常缺乏深度感知等视觉线索，这相当于维度降低了一维。因此，它们在手稿中的使用较不常见或不直接。在这项实证研究中，在一家学术机构内进行了一项在线调查，旨在根据阅读时间和准确性来识别和量化三维散点图中特征或特征组合的有效性。
AI.summary: 本研究是一项实证调查，旨在解决将三维散点图投影为二维图形时，科学软件表示方法不一致且缺乏有效性量化证据的问题。研究动机在于缺乏深度感知线索会降低图表的维度和可用性。研究方法是在学术机构内进行在线调查，以量化三维散点图中的特征或特征组合在阅读时间和准确性方面的有效性。
AI.keywords: 三维散点图, 二维投影, 实证研究, 深度感知, 可视化评估
AI.comments: 这篇论文的创新点在于它试图对传统的三维数据可视化方法（三维散点图）的二维表示进行量化评估。虽然三维散点图很常见，但研究指出，缺乏一致的表示方法和深度线索会严重影响其有效性。通过实证研究和量化指标（阅读时间和准确性），该研究有望为科学软件和手稿中三维图表的最佳实践提供明确的、基于证据的指导，填补现有知识的空白。

title: Parameter Training Efficiency Aware Resource Allocation for AIGC in Space-Air-Ground Integrated Networks
comments: This paper was accepted by IEEE Transactions on Mobile Computing (TMC) on 27th December 2025
summary: With the evolution of artificial intelligence-generated content (AIGC) techniques and the development of space-air-ground integrated networks (SAGIN), there will be a growing opportunity to enhance more users' mobile experience with customized AIGC applications. This is made possible through the use of parameter-efficient fine-tuning (PEFT) training alongside mobile edge computing. In this paper, we formulate the optimization problem of maximizing the parameter training efficiency of the SAGIN system over wireless networks under limited resource constraints. We propose the Parameter training efficiency Aware Resource Allocation (PARA) technique to jointly optimize user association, data offloading, and communication and computational resource allocation. Solid proofs are presented to solve this difficult sum of ratios problem based on quadratically constrained quadratic programming (QCQP), semidefinite programming (SDP), graph theory, and fractional programming (FP) techniques. Our proposed PARA technique is effective in finding a stationary point of this non-convex problem. The simulation results demonstrate that the proposed PARA method outperforms other baselines.

AI.title_translation: 面向空天地一体化网络中AIGC的参数训练效率感知资源分配
AI.tldr: 为提升空天地一体化网络（SAGIN）中定制化AIGC应用的移动体验，本文提出参数训练效率感知资源分配（PARA）技术，通过联合优化用户关联、数据卸载和资源分配，利用QCQP、SDP和FP等方法最大化系统参数训练效率，并在仿真中表现优于基线。
AI.motivation: 随着AIGC技术和空天地一体化网络（SAGIN）的发展，利用参数高效微调（PEFT）和移动边缘计算（MEC）来增强用户移动体验和定制化AIGC应用的机会日益增加。本文旨在解决在有限资源约束下，最大化SAGIN系统参数训练效率的优化问题。
AI.method: 提出参数训练效率感知资源分配（PARA）技术。该方法旨在联合优化用户关联、数据卸载以及通信和计算资源分配。为解决这一困难的非凸“比率之和”问题，该技术利用了二次约束二次规划（QCQP）、半定规划（SDP）、图论和分式规划（FP）等技术，并提供了可靠的证明。
AI.result: 提出的PARA技术能够有效地找到这一非凸问题的稳定点。仿真结果表明，所提出的PARA方法优于其他基线方法。
AI.translation: 随着人工智能生成内容（AIGC）技术的演进和空天地一体化网络（SAGIN）的发展，通过利用参数高效微调（PEFT）训练和移动边缘计算，增强更多用户移动体验的定制化AIGC应用的机会将不断增加。在本文中，我们提出了在有限资源约束下，最大化无线网络中SAGIN系统参数训练效率的优化问题。我们提出了参数训练效率感知资源分配（PARA）技术，以联合优化用户关联、数据卸载以及通信和计算资源分配。本文提出了可靠的证明来解决这一困难的“比率之和”问题，这些证明基于二次约束二次规划（QCQP）、半定规划（SDP）、图论和分式规划（FP）技术。我们提出的PARA技术在寻找这一非凸问题的稳定点方面是有效的。仿真结果表明，所提出的PARA方法优于其他基线方法。
AI.summary: 本文关注在空天地一体化网络（SAGIN）中为AIGC应用分配资源以最大化参数训练效率的问题。研究人员将此问题建模为一个在有限资源约束下的“比率之和”优化问题，并提出了参数训练效率感知资源分配（PARA）技术。PARA通过联合优化用户关联、数据卸载、通信和计算资源来解决此非凸问题。该技术利用二次约束二次规划（QCQP）、半定规划（SDP）、图论和分式规划（FP）等高级优化工具来寻找稳定点。仿真结果验证了PARA方法优于现有基线。
AI.keywords: 空天地一体化网络（SAGIN）, AIGC, 参数训练效率, 资源分配, 参数高效微调（PEFT）
AI.comments: 本文的创新点在于将参数训练效率（特别是针对AIGC和PEFT）作为核心优化目标，并将其融入到复杂的空天地一体化网络（SAGIN）资源分配框架中。这种结合反映了当前AI模型部署对网络资源提出的新要求。通过使用二次约束二次规划（QCQP）、半定规划（SDP）和分式规划（FP）等多种高级优化技术来解决非凸的“比率之和”问题，显示了研究人员在处理复杂系统优化方面的技术深度。该研究对于未来SAGIN支持大规模、定制化移动AI应用的实际部署具有重要意义。

title: From Transformers to LLMs: A Systematic Survey of Efficiency Considerations in NLP
summary: The emergence of Transformer-based Large Language Models (LLMs) has substantially augmented the capabilities of Natural Language Processing (NLP), thereby intensifying the demand for computational resources. Therefore, enhancing efficiency based on factors like computational requirements, energy consumption, carbon footprint and financial cost has become a vital area of research. This motivates us to conduct a systematic literature review on Transformer-based LLMs in NLP from the perspective of efficiency. In this survey of 312 articles published between the years 2011 and 2025, efficiency-improvement endeavors have been systematically discussed targeting various aspects such as data curation, model design, model downsizing, and dynamic inferencing. This has been augmented with efficiency considerations in model adaptation strategies like pre-training, fine-tuning, prompt-engineering and Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG). Furthermore, a statistical analysis of the articles has been performed followed by an in-depth evaluation of the efficiency and efficacy of more than 30 renowned NLP models has been conducted on 13 evaluation benchmarks. This paper offers valuable insights for researchers, professionals as well as scholars, and explores the trend of research toward sustainable practices in NLP.

AI.title_translation: 从Transformer到LLM：自然语言处理中效率考量的系统综述
AI.tldr: 本文是对312篇关于Transformer和LLM效率的论文进行的系统综述。它讨论了如何通过数据整理、模型设计、模型小型化和适应策略（如RAG）来降低计算资源需求、能耗和成本，并评估了30多个模型的效率，旨在推动NLP的可持续发展。
AI.motivation: 基于Transformer的大型语言模型（LLMs）的出现显著增强了自然语言处理（NLP）的能力，但也加剧了对计算资源的需求。因此，提高基于计算要求、能耗、碳足迹和财务成本等因素的效率已成为一个至关重要的研究领域。
AI.method: 进行了一项系统的文献综述，涵盖2011年至2025年间的312篇文章。系统地讨论了针对数据整理、模型设计、模型小型化和动态推理等方面的效率改进工作。补充讨论了预训练、微调、提示工程和检索增强生成（RAG）等模型适应策略中的效率考量。此外，对文章进行了统计分析，并对30多个知名NLP模型在13个评估基准上的效率和有效性进行了深入评估。
AI.result: 提供了对研究人员、专业人士和学者有价值的见解，并探索了NLP中迈向可持续实践的研究趋势。
AI.conclusion: 为研究人员、专业人士和学者提供了宝贵的见解，并探索了自然语言处理中迈向可持续实践的研究趋势。
AI.translation: 基于Transformer的大型语言模型（LLMs）的出现显著增强了自然语言处理（NLP）的能力，从而加剧了对计算资源的需求。因此，提高基于计算要求、能耗、碳足迹和财务成本等因素的效率已成为一个至关重要的研究领域。这促使我们从效率的角度对NLP中基于Transformer的LLMs进行系统性的文献综述。在这项涵盖2011年至2025年间发表的312篇文章的综述中，系统地讨论了针对数据整理、模型设计、模型小型化和动态推理等各个方面的效率改进工作。同时，还补充了预训练、微调、提示工程和检索增强生成（RAG）等模型适应策略中的效率考量。此外，对文章进行了统计分析，并对30多个知名NLP模型在13个评估基准上的效率和有效性进行了深入评估。本文为研究人员、专业人士以及学者提供了宝贵的见解，并探索了NLP中迈向可持续实践的研究趋势。
AI.summary: 鉴于基于Transformer的大型语言模型（LLMs）对计算资源的高需求，本系统综述旨在解决自然语言处理（NLP）中效率提升的关键需求。该综述分析了312篇文章，详细阐述了贯穿模型生命周期各个阶段的效率策略，包括数据整理、模型设计、小型化、动态推理以及RAG和提示工程等适应技术。这项工作包括统计分析和对30多个知名NLP模型在13个基准上的评估，为可持续研究趋势提供了重要见解。
AI.keywords: Transformer, LLM, 效率, 系统综述, NLP
AI.comments: 这是一项非常及时且重要的系统综述。它的重要性在于综合了关于LLM效率的零散研究，这对于实际部署和环境可持续性至关重要。该综述的范围令人印象深刻（涵盖312篇文章，时间跨度从2011年到2025年，暗示了前瞻性分析）。其结构化方法——解决了整个模型流程（数据、设计、适应、推理）中的效率问题——是一个主要优势。它为未来专注于可持续和高成本效益的NLP研究提供了必要的路线图。

title: Test-time generative augmentation for medical image segmentation
comments: Accepted for publication in Medical Image Analysis (MedIA). Finalized version. Vol. 109, March 2026
summary: Medical image segmentation is critical for clinical diagnosis, treatment planning, and monitoring, yet segmentation models often struggle with uncertainties stemming from occlusions, ambiguous boundaries, and variations in imaging devices. Traditional test-time augmentation (TTA) techniques typically rely on predefined geometric and photometric transformations, limiting their adaptability and effectiveness in complex medical scenarios. In this study, we introduced Test-Time Generative Augmentation (TTGA), a novel augmentation strategy specifically tailored for medical image segmentation at inference time. Different from conventional augmentation strategies that suffer from excessive randomness or limited flexibility, TTGA leverages a domain-fine-tuned generative model to produce contextually relevant and diverse augmentations tailored to the characteristics of each test image. Built upon diffusion model inversion, a masked null-text inversion method is proposed to enable region-specific augmentations during sampling. Furthermore, a dual denoising pathway is designed to balance precise identity preservation with controlled variability. We demonstrate the efficacy of our TTGA through extensive experiments across three distinct segmentation tasks spanning nine datasets. Our results consistently demonstrate that TTGA not only improves segmentation accuracy (with DSC gains ranging from 0.1% to 2.3% over the baseline) but also offers pixel-wise error estimation (with DSC gains ranging from 1.1% to 29.0% over the baseline). The source code and demonstration are available at: https://github.com/maxiao0234/TTGA.

AI.title_translation: 医用图像分割的测试时生成式增强
AI.tldr: 针对医学图像分割中的不确定性问题，本文提出了测试时生成式增强（TTGA），它利用领域微调的生成模型（基于扩散模型反演和掩码空文本反演）生成上下文相关的多样化增强图像，显著提高了分割精度和像素级误差估计能力。
AI.motivation: 医用图像分割模型常受遮挡、模糊边界和成像设备差异带来的不确定性影响。传统的测试时增强（TTA）依赖预定义的几何和光度变换，缺乏适应性和灵活性。
AI.method: 提出了一种新颖的测试时生成式增强（TTGA）策略。它利用领域微调的生成模型来生成上下文相关且多样化的增强。具体方法基于扩散模型反演，并提出了掩码空文本反演方法实现区域特异性增强，同时设计了双重去噪路径来平衡身份精确保持和可控变异性。
AI.result: TTGA在跨越九个数据集的三个不同分割任务中得到验证。结果显示，TTGA不仅提高了分割精度（DSC增益比基线提高了0.1%至2.3%），而且提供了像素级误差估计（DSC增益比基线提高了1.1%至29.0%）。
AI.translation: 医用图像分割对于临床诊断、治疗计划和监测至关重要，但分割模型经常受到遮挡、模糊边界和成像设备差异带来的不确定性影响。传统的测试时增强（TTA）技术通常依赖预定义的几何和光度变换，限制了它们在复杂医疗场景中的适应性和有效性。在本研究中，我们引入了测试时生成式增强（TTGA），这是一种专门为推理时的医用图像分割量身定制的新型增强策略。与遭受过度随机性或有限灵活性的传统增强策略不同，TTGA利用领域微调的生成模型来生成针对每个测试图像特征的、上下文相关且多样化的增强。基于扩散模型反演，本文提出了一种掩码空文本反演方法，以在采样过程中实现区域特异性增强。此外，还设计了双重去噪路径，以平衡精确的身份保留和受控的变异性。我们通过对跨越九个数据集的三个不同分割任务的广泛实验证明了TTGA的有效性。我们的结果一致表明，TTGA不仅提高了分割精度（DSC增益比基线提高了0.1%至2.3%），而且提供了像素级误差估计（DSC增益比基线提高了1.1%至29.0%）。源代码和演示可在以下链接获取：https://github.com/maxiao0234/TTGA。
AI.summary: 本文提出了一种用于医学图像分割的新型推理时增强策略——测试时生成式增强（TTGA）。为解决传统TTA的局限性及医学图像分割中的不确定性，TTGA利用领域微调的生成模型（基于扩散模型反演和掩码空文本反演）生成上下文相关且多样化的增强图像。该方法还设计了双重去噪路径来优化变异性控制。实验证明，TTGA在多项分割任务中显著提高了分割精度和像素级误差估计能力。
AI.keywords: 医用图像分割, 测试时增强, 生成式增强, 扩散模型, 不确定性估计
AI.comments: 本文的创新点在于将生成模型（特别是基于扩散模型的反演技术）引入到测试时增强（TTA）领域，解决了传统TTA在医学图像分割中适应性差的问题。通过生成上下文相关、区域特异性的增强样本，TTGA能够更好地模拟真实世界的不确定性，从而提高模型的鲁棒性和精度。此外，其提供像素级误差估计的能力，对于临床应用中的不确定性量化具有重要价值。

title: LeanQuant: Accurate and Scalable Large Language Model Quantization with Loss-error-aware Grid
summary: Large language models (LLMs) have shown immense potential across various domains, but their high memory requirements and inference costs remain critical challenges for deployment. Post-training quantization (PTQ) has emerged as a promising technique to reduce memory requirements and decoding latency. However, recent accurate quantization methods often depend on specialized computations or custom data formats to achieve better model quality, which limits their compatibility with popular frameworks, as they require dedicated inference kernels tailored to specific hardware and software platforms, hindering wider adoption. Furthermore, many competitive methods have high resource requirements and computational overhead for quantizing models, making it challenging to scale them to hundreds of billions of parameters. In response to these challenges, we propose LeanQuant (Loss-Error-Aware Network Quantization), a novel quantization method that is accurate, versatile, and scalable. In the existing popular iterative loss-error-based quantization framework, we identify a critical limitation in prior methods: the min-max affine quantization grid fails to preserve model quality due to outliers in inverse Hessian diagonals. To overcome this fundamental issue, we propose learning loss-error-aware grids, instead of using non-adaptive min-max affine grids. Our approach not only produces quantized models that are more accurate but also generalizes to a wider range of quantization types, including affine and non-uniform quantization, enhancing compatibility with more frameworks. Extensive experiments with recent LLMs demonstrate that LeanQuant is highly accurate, comparing favorably against competitive baselines in model quality, and scalable, achieving very accurate quantization of Llama-3.1 405B, one of the largest open-source LLMs to date, using two Quadro RTX 8000-48GB GPUs in 21 hours.

AI.title_translation: LeanQuant：基于损失误差感知网格的准确且可扩展的大语言模型量化
AI.tldr: LeanQuant是一种用于大语言模型的准确且可扩展的后训练量化（PTQ）方法。它用损失误差感知网格取代了有缺陷的min-max网格，显著提高了量化精度和框架兼容性，并成功在21小时内量化了Llama-3.1 405B。
AI.motivation: 大语言模型（LLMs）的内存需求和推理成本高昂。现有的准确量化方法依赖专用计算或自定义数据格式，限制了与流行框架的兼容性。此外，许多有竞争力的量化方法资源需求和计算开销高，难以扩展到数百亿参数的模型。在现有的迭代损失误差量化框架中，min-max仿射量化网格由于逆Hessian对角线中的异常值而无法保持模型质量。
AI.method: 提出LeanQuant（损失误差感知网络量化）方法。该方法的核心是通过学习“损失误差感知网格”，取代在现有迭代损失误差量化框架中失效的非自适应min-max仿射网格。
AI.result: LeanQuant生成的量化模型更准确，并可推广到更广泛的量化类型（包括仿射和非均匀量化），增强了兼容性。实验证明，LeanQuant与有竞争力的基线相比，在模型质量上表现优异，并且具有可扩展性，使用两块Quadro RTX 8000-48GB GPU在21小时内完成了Llama-3.1 405B的准确量化。
AI.conclusion: LeanQuant是一种准确、通用且可扩展的量化方法。通过引入损失误差感知网格，它克服了现有方法中min-max网格的局限性，提高了量化精度和框架兼容性，并成功应用于超大规模模型。
AI.translation: 大语言模型（LLMs）在各个领域展现出巨大的潜力，但其高内存需求和推理成本仍然是部署的关键挑战。后训练量化（PTQ）已成为一种有前景的技术，用于减少内存需求和解码延迟。然而，最近准确的量化方法通常依赖于专用计算或自定义数据格式来实现更好的模型质量，这限制了它们与流行框架的兼容性，因为它们需要针对特定硬件和软件平台定制的推理内核，阻碍了更广泛的应用。此外，许多有竞争力的量化方法在量化模型时具有高资源需求和计算开销，使得它们难以扩展到数百亿参数。针对这些挑战，我们提出了LeanQuant（损失误差感知网络量化），这是一种新颖的、准确、通用且可扩展的量化方法。在现有的流行的基于迭代损失误差的量化框架中，我们发现现有方法的一个关键局限性：由于逆Hessian对角线中的异常值，min-max仿射量化网格未能保持模型质量。为了克服这一根本问题，我们建议学习损失误差感知网格，而不是使用非自适应的min-max仿射网格。我们的方法不仅生成的量化模型更准确，而且还可以推广到更广泛的量化类型，包括仿射和非均匀量化，从而增强了与更多框架的兼容性。对最新LLMs进行的广泛实验表明，LeanQuant具有高度准确性，在模型质量上优于有竞争力的基线，并且具有可扩展性，使用两块Quadro RTX 8000-48GB GPU在21小时内实现了Llama-3.1 405B（迄今为止最大的开源LLM之一）的非常准确的量化。
AI.summary: 本文提出了LeanQuant（损失误差感知网络量化），这是一种新颖的后训练量化（PTQ）方法，旨在解决现有LLM量化技术中资源消耗高和兼容性有限的问题。LeanQuant通过识别标准min-max仿射网格因异常值而失效的局限性，提出学习损失误差感知网格。该方法不仅提高了量化模型的准确性，还具有通用性，可推广到仿射和非均匀量化等多种类型，增强了与流行框架的兼容性。实验证明，LeanQuant在模型质量上优于现有基线，并展现出卓越的可扩展性，能够高效地对Llama-3.1 405B等超大规模模型进行准确量化。
AI.keywords: 大语言模型, 后训练量化, 损失误差感知网格, 可扩展性
AI.comments: LeanQuant的主要创新在于在现有的迭代损失误差量化框架中，用学习到的“损失误差感知网格”取代了非自适应的min-max仿射网格，从而解决了逆Hessian对角线中异常值导致的模型质量下降问题。这一改进提高了量化精度和泛化能力。该研究的重要性在于同时解决了LLM量化部署中的两大关键挑战：兼容性（通过支持更广泛的量化类型，避免专用内核）和可扩展性（成功高效地量化了405B规模的模型）。这一方法的通用性和可扩展性对于推动LLM的广泛、低成本部署至关重要。

title: A Pairwise Comparison Relation-assisted Multi-objective Evolutionary Neural Architecture Search Method with Multi-population Mechanism
comments: Accepted by IEEE Transactions on Systems, Man, and Cybernetics: Systems. Published on https://ieeexplore.ieee.org/document/11321923
summary: Neural architecture search (NAS) has emerged as a powerful paradigm that enables researchers to automatically explore vast search spaces and discover efficient neural networks. However, NAS suffers from a critical bottleneck, i.e. the evaluation of numerous architectures during the search process demands substantial computing resources and time. In order to improve the efficiency of NAS, a series of methods have been proposed to reduce the evaluation time of neural architectures. However, they are not efficient enough and still only focus on the accuracy of architectures. Beyond classification accuracy, real-world applications increasingly demand more efficient and compact network architectures that balance multiple performance criteria. To address these challenges, we propose the SMEMNAS, a pairwise comparison relation-assisted multi-objective evolutionary algorithm based on a multi-population mechanism. In the SMEMNAS, a surrogate model is constructed based on pairwise comparison relations to predict the accuracy ranking of architectures, rather than the absolute accuracy. Moreover, two populations cooperate with each other in the search process, i.e. a main population that guides the evolutionary process, while a vice population that enhances search diversity. Our method aims to discover high-performance models that simultaneously optimize multiple objectives. We conduct comprehensive experiments on CIFAR-10, CIFAR-100 and ImageNet datasets to validate the effectiveness of our approach. With only a single GPU searching for 0.17 days, competitive architectures can be found by SMEMNAS which achieves 78.91% accuracy with the MAdds of 570M on the ImageNet. This work makes a significant advancement in the field of NAS.
